question: Which divine authorities are invoked or attained through the power of this recitation?
premises: Śakra is lord of the gods.
The glorious Bṛhaspati is preceptor of the gods.
These figures represent supreme divine authority.
inference: The recitation aligns the practitioner with the highest divine authorities.
plain_english: Śakra is the glorious lord of the gods, and Bṛhaspati is the preceptor of the gods.
